title: A report your manager can read
hints: README → New syntax: printf widths `%-10s %5d`, and awk's `| "sort"` with `close()` (or a shell `{ ...; }` group).
Count users per team, skipping the header. In END: printf the header row, printf each team through sort, close sort, then printf TOTAL (= NR - 1).
`awk -F, 'NR > 1 {n[$4]++} END {printf "%-10s %5s\n", "TEAM", "USERS"; for (t in n) printf ... | "sort"; close("sort"); printf ...}'`.
